value.rationale: Equal-strength integer shear cat maps are a canonical hyperbolic family, and first-lag prediction of the natural centered product coordinate is a nontrivial and well-motivated observable invariant. The unique cancellation at the weakest shear, strict negative correlation for every larger integer strength, exact high-shear coefficient and nonzero second lag at the exceptional parameter quantify an otherwise unsummed Fourier observable; the result is not a renamed qualitative mixing statement.
